verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows New Relic's core platform can be self-hosted: the docs describe agents and OpenTelemetry forwarding data to New Relic's cloud. Community comments contrast New Relic with on-prem APM options and complain about latency of the cloud-hosted version, which suggests SaaS-only delivery.
